quintero-cuba--linea-clasica.description: Quintero is one of the few Habanos brands born outside Havana: Agustín Quintero founded it after settling in Cienfuegos, the city called the Pearl of the South. Its blend draws on Vuelta Abajo leaf, and the cigars are made totally by hand with short filler. The smoke is straightforward, built on wood and leather, with a sweet, caramel-like edge in the thicker sizes.

thirds.notes: A lively, spicy opening with dense smoke and an unexpected caramel-candy sweetness; this is the strongest stretch.
Spice and strength ease off, leaving gentle warmth on the palate and a sweet finish that recalls dried coconut.
Sweetness and a hint of coconut carry on with a little wood, and the finish turns very light.

sources.title: Cigar Inspector – Quintero Londres Extra review
